critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven across desktop, tablet, and mobile: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. However, normal-motion sampling does not demonstrate a smooth progression. Mid-frame values are effectively identical to the end state on desktop and tablet, and exactly identical on mobile, indicating an abrupt or heavily front-loaded transition rather than visible interpolation. Performance is acceptable on tablet/mobile (16.87–17.28 ms averages, no long frames), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame.
critique.fix: Retune the duration/easing so measured quarter-, mid-, and three-quarter frames show clear progressive opacity and transform changes instead of reaching the final state by midpoint. Profile desktop to approach a 16.7 ms average and eliminate the 50 ms spike, while preserving the verified reduced-motion override.
